title: HB1445 (2020 Regular): Firearms; revise elements for crime of possession of a stolen firearm.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2020/html/HB/1400-1499/HB1445IN.htm)
provenance.note: As-filed text. Only a period-to-semicolon punctuation strike in (3)(b) besides the added words; penalties in (3)-(4) unchanged and not quoted. No passage vote.

operative_text: Section 1 (Miss. Code § 97-37-35): (1) It is unlawful for any person knowingly or intentionally to possess, receive, retain, acquire or obtain possession or dispose of a stolen firearm or attempt to possess, receive, retain, acquire or obtain possession or dispose of a stolen firearm with reasonable grounds to believe that the firearm was stolen. (2) It is unlawful for any person knowingly or intentionally to sell, deliver or transfer a stolen firearm or attempt to sell, deliver or transfer a stolen firearm with reasonable grounds to believe that the firearm was stolen.
